writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

forbiddenWrites: live runtime, Task Scheduler, network, external model or public state

redEvidence.failure: KeyError: generation at the real L7 stage result boundary
redEvidence.productionCause: InstallCutoverController.stage returns INSTALL_STAGE_RESULT_V1 without the S6-required generation, journal and installedReceipt evidence

preserve: all stage, cutover, rollback, resume, journal, security and HumanImpact behavior
existing CUTOVER_RESULT_V1 and ROLLBACK_RESULT_V1 result shapes
journal on-disk schema and hash so this correction does not invalidate durable preimages
stageResultRules: generation is the already validated INSTALL_AUTHORITY_V1 integer; bool is impossible because authority validation precedes the result
journal is a deep copy of the validated current durable journal and journal.journalSha256 equals top-level journalSha256
stage retry/resume returns the same semantic evidence for the same journal and authority
do not add generation to the persisted journal schema; authoritySha256 already binds it and resume revalidates the exact authority
installedReceiptRules: all values derive only from the already validated authority and durable journal
receiptSha256 is canonical SHA-256 of the other exact receipt fields
no secret, traceback, environment value or unvalidated caller field is added
requiredImplementation.implementationShape: introduce one stage-only result helper and call it from both stage return paths; leave generic _result and its cutover/rollback callers unchanged

verification.directProbe: construct the existing S5 test helper boundary under pytest temp ownership and assert the exact eight stage keys, exact nine installed receipt keys, both hashes, generation=authority generation, and semantic equality on retry
verification.s6AfterIntegration: Test Luna owns the pending test diff and performs the authoritative exact 6-pass run after this commit is integrated
verification.diff: git diff --check and exact one owned production path only

commitPolicy.message: fix: expose sealed S5 stage evidence

causalRetry: one implementation attempt and one causally distinct correction only; do not change tests or broaden result contracts
delivery: source hash/bytes, exact stage/receipt key and hash probe, S5 9-pass evidence, commit and clean status
stopPolicy: return to Sol on unexpected behavior; no tests, live state or global-harness mutation
